g.title: HR_COMPGRIDROWQST
g.text: Competency Grid Row Question - Defines, for each competency grid, one or more questions whose answer score will influence the competency score calculation.
Indicates the weighting as a percentage
A number indicating the importance of the entity it relates to.
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation

g.title: HR_COMPGRIDROW
g.text: Competency Grid Row - This represents the link between Competencies and Grid.
The Compentency Grid to be used
Indicates the weighting as a percentage
A number indicating the importance of the entity it relates to.
This field is used to override the standard competency description within a specific grid.
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation
